bothPlatforms: Web and mobile app — one account, the same data.
ctaBody: Al-Fatiha is seven verses. That is enough to see whether the method suits you.
f1Body: All 604 pages, line by line. Four masking levels — full text, first word of each line, first letters, then nothing — moving from reading to recall without changing screen.
f2Body: A long press on a word gives its translation and pronunciation, with audio of the isolated word. Useful when a verse catches on one term.
f3Body: Verses return when you are about to forget them, not in Quranic order. The review queue is built from your past answers.
f4Body: A group, live discussion, audio and video calls. The teacher listens to a submitted recitation and either approves it or returns it with a comment.
f5Body: The 60 hizb split across members: the group completes a full reading that nobody would have finished alone.
f6Body: Computed from your position, with direction and distance to Mecca. When the magnetometer is missing, the app says so instead of pretending.
family2: Real activity tracking, day by day
familyNote: The parental dashboard shows measured data only.
featuresLead: Every point below is live — nothing here is announced for later.
free2: Progressive masking and word by word
methodLead: Memorisation rests on a cycle, not a tool. The app only keeps that cycle regular.
plusNote: Plans will go through the App Store and Google Play. No payment is active for now.
pricingLead: Reading, memorising and reviewing are not behind a paywall, and never will be.
s1Body: The verse is recited by the reciter you choose. The ear takes the imprint of the rhythm before the eye starts working.
s2Body: The text fades progressively. Each level removes one support, until none is left.
s3Body: What you recite without hesitation comes back later; what catches comes back soon. That is spaced repetition.
s4Body: A recording sent to your teacher, listened to, then approved or commented. Correction comes from a person, not an automatic score.
subtitle: The full mushaf with progressive masking, review that returns at the right moment, and a halaqa where a teacher truly listens to your recitation.
title: Memorize the Quran without losing what you’ve learned
